name: Armored Weyland-Yutani Commando
method: Integrated OpenAI image_gen native generation with one project atlas as identity/style reference. No CLI/API fallback. PNG bytes copied unchanged; no resizing, recoloring, alpha editing or normalization.

reference.role: base identity and style; not edit target
reference.notes: Ivory environmental suit, grille helmet with goggles, black life-support pack and carbine preserve the existing commando sprite identity. Extra armor is a project modifier; not a separate screen-canonical uniform.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one dedicated static 2D side-view game sprite with native transparency, for Alien: Tantalus Frontier.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND BASE IDENTITY REFERENCE: the existing Weyland-Yutani Commando sprite atlas. Do NOT reproduce the grid or multiple figures.
Primary request: ONE Armored Weyland-Yutani Commando. Base the figure on the supplied project's interpretation of the Alien 3 commando: padded off-white industrial environmental suit, ivory armored chest, white helmet with dark top, opaque dark goggles and distinctive protective cage or grille over the respirator, ribbed black life-support backpack and hoses, gloves, utilitarian boots, and one compact custom pulse-style carbine held in both hands. Retain human proportions. Make the existing project's Armored modifier visible through reinforced ivory shoulder guards, forearm plates and heavier shin plates; this reinforcement is a project adaptation rather than a claim of a separate canonical uniform.
Style/medium: match the supplied reference's finely painted realistic game sprite style, crisp silhouette, muted ivory and charcoal, scratched industrial finishes, softly shaded volumes, readable at small gameplay scale. Not a photo, not pixel art.
Composition/framing: lateral gameplay view facing RIGHT, weapon directed safely down-right in a neutral ready stance, whole helmet/backpack/gun/hands/both soles visible, feet planted and separated. One isolated centered figure with at least 10 percent genuinely transparent padding on every side. No floor or ground shadow.
Constraints: actual transparent RGBA background; no scene, no grid, no extra figure or detached weapon, no muzzle flash, no projectiles, no labels, no text, no logo, no watermark, no gore. One independent full-body pose only, not an animation sheet.

runtimeContract.geometryPolicy: Draw whole native PNG at isotropic scale; do not crop transparent padding or normalize. Existing profile stats and collider remain authoritative.
runtimeContract.pivotReview: X is approximate pelvis/support center from full-body visual inspection; Y is complete lowest sole alpha bound. Parent integration must verify actor ground contact and visual size.

review.visual: Full figure including feet and equipment, right-facing near-side three-quarter gameplay pose, no unexpected duplicate figure, text or environment. Armor variants are visually distinct from their base atlases.
review.alphaComposite: Viewed all three native RGBA images actually composited in local Chrome on white, black and checkerboard. No opaque matte or visible diffuse halo at gallery scale. Raw RGB preview halo on Joe is not present in real composites.
review.limits: Gallery-scale inspection only, not exhaustive 100% pixel QC. Requested 10% padding not achieved on every edge; measured visible margin minimum >5%. Slight near-side three-quarter view, not geometrically exact orthographic side profile. All three are generated project adaptations, never certified 1:1 canon. Static poses only; historical animation-clip production remains pending.
